Advisor ruling 2026-10-29 20:35 (PR-3113 design calls, claude-advisor-08):
1. "Latest ruling comment" instead of "rulings newer than the last push": ACCEPTED, for the reason given (the TASK-116 ruling predated the rework comment).
2. --ruling is recorded before rework can refuse: ACCEPTED. A ruling is a durable record whether or not the relaunch happens.
Supervised spec: the advisor ships under the ship-held mandate once the attested review approves at head and CI is green on that head. Do NOT merge it yourself.
Blocking now: CI lib-0 and Build fail help_surface_matches_golden_snapshot. Merge origin/main (merge, no rebase), regenerate the golden help snapshot, and push. The reviewer launch was refused because the base is stale and overlaps a file; it relaunches after your push.
Note: your mail to advisor was stranded in your seat clone (filed as BUG-031). Your PR-3113 summary reached the advisor only through the operator.
subject: PR-3113 rulings: both design calls accepted; merge main and fix the snapshot
